resolution_review.raw_criterion_preserved: best <0.5% and >=2 steps <1%; float32 native forward
resolution_review.interpretation: The unchanged weak directional derivative is not resolved reliably enough by this float32 forward to confirm or refute a defect at the original relative tolerance. Exact repeated-input determinism gives zero run-to-run noise, but one-ULP material probes reveal comparable material-dependent forward quantization, and neighboring h changes the error sign. Original raw FAIL is retained; no PASS is inferred.
resolution_review.limitations: The sum of observed endpoint one-ULP residual maxima is an empirical resolution indicator, not a rigorous roundoff bound or statistical confidence interval. Linear material effects use baseline AD and are tiny compared with observed jumps, especially face-only probes. All-plus/random probes include interior cells and measure the local objective resolution rather than changing the FD direction. No claim that the production gradient is correct follows; higher forward precision or an independent analytical oracle is required to settle this weak derivative. Existing PML FAILs are unaffected.
